chunks: 2419 - It is narrated from al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah that he said:

I held the stirrup for Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام while he intended to mount, and he raised his head and then smiled. So I said: O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, I saw you raise your head and smile. He said: “Yes, O Aṣbagh, I held the stirrup for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله just as you held it for me, and he raised his head toward the sky and smiled. I asked him just as you asked me, and I shall inform you just as he informed me.

I held al-Shahbāʾ for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and he raised his head toward the sky and smiled. So I said: O Messenger of Allah, you raised your head toward the sky and smiled. He said: “O ʿAlī, there is no one who rides what Allah has bestowed upon him, then recites the verse of subjugation, then says: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the One who...
There is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting.

and I repent to Him. O Allah, forgive my sins, for indeed none forgives sins except You—except that the Noble Master says: ‘O My angels, My servant knows that none forgives sins other than Me. Bear witness that I have indeed forgiven his sins.’”

key_terms.آيَةَ السُّخْرَةِ: the Quranic verse recited upon mounting and benefiting from a subdued ride
key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الْكَرِيمُ: the Noble Master, referring to Allah with majesty and generosity
key_terms.الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ: the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting; divine attributes invoked in supplication
key_terms.بِالرِّكَابِ: the stirrup of the mount being held for the rider
key_terms.ذُنُوبِي: my sins, for which forgiveness is sought

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when mounting a ride according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a sunnah (prophetic tradition) of reciting a supplication when mounting a ride, beginning with the verse of subjugation and followed by seeking forgiveness. It emphasizes tawhid, repentance, and recognition that only Allah forgives sins. The narration also preserves a moment of transmission from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام.
